question: Which components and sage are named in this mantra enumeration?
premises: The verse names mahāmāyā, vāgbhava, mānmatha, sarga-vān, and Bhṛgu.
inference: Great illusion, speech-born, love-born, creation-possessing, and Bhṛgu are named.
plain_english: Great illusion, speech-born, love-born, creation-possessing, and Bhrgu are named.
